threshold_definitions.flux_residual: max component discrepancy divided by max(1,abs(flux_left),abs(flux_right)); both native and independently dimensionalized checks
threshold_definitions.characteristic_guard: minimum distance of abs(front-relative normal speed) to any characteristic speed, divided by max(1,all speeds); the same relative guard on characteristic-speed coincidences
threshold_definitions.entropy_guard: dimensionless log(p2/p1)-gamma*log(X); ordinary accepted shock must exceed the guard
threshold_definitions.tangential_LOS_relative: abs(v_t dot ell)/max(1 km/s, norm(v_t)); explicitly calculated for both constructed states and their difference
threshold_definitions.guard_policy: Guarded candidates are UNRESOLVED, retained in root records and never used for a decisive ordinary-family claim. Existing R131 diagnostic thresholds are unchanged; the extra R132 conditioning guards are applied separately.

ASSUMED.field_azimuth: e1 parallel n cross LOS; same R131 polarity convention
ASSUMED.aperture_and_reference: R131 selected R127 central rows334-338, exposure25, reference1-10; no re-selection

fixed_constraints.MODEL_DERIVED: D,mu,compression,upstream state,field strengths,and velocity jumps recomputed from those fixed inputs; none independently adjustable

scan.refinement_rule: bisect cells whose corner classes, root counts, or unresolved flags differ; refine guard locations; stop at .125deg or global cap. No family-preferred ordering.
scan.outside_domain: not mapped; no grid exclusion extrapolated outside domain

root_enumeration: Complete stable quadratic formula in positive field-squared variable z; complex/negative roots retained; repeated/degree-loss roots guarded; no finite B search cutoff.

joint_uncertainty.precision_policy: Angular separation of examples is not a family precision. Boxes must retain an admissible candidate and exclude all competing-family possibilities supported by the calculation; sampling-only claims are labelled as such.

delivery_status: review results only; no update ZIP, BUNDLE_MANIFEST_R132 or final checkpoint until user review

source_credits.surface_speed: Veronig et al.2011, saved R131 provenance
source_credits.spectroscopic_reductions: saved R127/R130 RMO reductions with retained source, atomic-data and software provenance
